definitions.gloss: decolorizing agent; bleach used to remove color
definitions.explanation: A chemical product that removes color from hair, fabric, or other material. Especially common for the hair bleach used to lighten hair before dyeing.

examples.japanese: {脱色剤|だっしょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{脱色剤|だっしょくざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Before dyeing the hair, you lighten it with a decolorizing agent.

examples.japanese: {脱色剤|だっしょくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Decolorizing agents are harsh, so be careful not to overuse them.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{脱色|だっしょく}→脱色：21855_dasshoku⟧ (removing color) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). Most often refers to hair bleach, but also to color removers for cloth or other materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱色剤|だっしょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply the decolorizing agent
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱色剤|だっしょくざい}: a commercially sold bleach

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}→漂白剤：07035_hyouhakuzai⟧: bleach — mainly for whitening laundry and removing stains
- ⟦{染料|せんりょう}→染料：16341_senryou⟧: dye — adds color rather than removing it
